hook: An ETH disproof, Qwen retrained, a spy memo and Elvis vs Suno
summary: OpenAI and Anthropic say their models disproved the 27-year-old Exponential Time Hypothesis, with Lean proofs on GitHub.
Nous Research cut Qwen's propaganda rate to under 1% in Arete-27B; a US memo reportedly says China sought to spy on Nvidia's CEO.
Apiiro found Claude Code approval files leaking secrets on GitHub, and Elvis Presley's estate sued Suno over voice cloning.

stories.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic AI models disprove Exponential Time Hypothesis
stories.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic stated that their AI models disproved the 27-year-old Exponential Time Hypothesis, upending research based on the premise that certain problems require exponential time to solve. Both firms published their proofs on GitHub in natural language and the machine-checkable Lean format.
stories.why_it_matters: The disproof of a foundational computer science hypothesis by AI models challenges decades of complexity theory and algorithm design research.
source_titles: Exponential Time Hypothesis co-proposer Russell Impagliazzo calls OpenAI's disproof "shocking news"; it could one day speed up chip design and break encryption (Cade Metz/New York Times)
How A.I. Just Blew Up a Key Tenet of Computer Science
An AI Breakthrough Has Made Decades of Computer Science Research ‘Irrelevant’
OpenAI Proves ETH Is False, and Crypto Twitter Has Questions
stories.line: OpenAI and Anthropic say a 27-year-old complexity conjecture is false
stories.detail: Both labs posted their Exponential Time Hypothesis proofs on GitHub, in plain language and Lean.

stories.headline: Nous Research releases Arete-27B after fine-tuning Alibaba model
stories.summary: Nous Research fine-tuned Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B model on 53 million tokens to create Arete-27B, reducing its rate of responses containing Chinese state propaganda from 22 percent to under one percent. The startup publicly released the model weights and training data.
stories.why_it_matters: This project demonstrates how supervised fine-tuning can alter the political alignment and state-mandated behaviors embedded in open-weight language models.
source_titles: Nous Research unveils Arete-27B, a post-trained Qwen3.8-27B model that reinforces Western values, saying the underlying Chinese model's bias layer is shallow (Nous Research)
State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away

stories.detail: 53M tokens of fine-tuning cut state-propaganda answers from 22% to under 1%; weights and data are public.

stories.headline: Megaspeed exec recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, US memo claims
stories.summary: A U.S. intelligence memo circulated to top policymakers claims that Megaspeed executive Alice Huang was recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The memo alleges the effort was intended to gather intelligence on American artificial intelligence chips.
stories.why_it_matters: This report connects national security intelligence and trade policy surrounding advanced American artificial intelligence hardware directly to Nvidia's leadership.
source_titles: Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo
Reports Show Chinese Spy Agency Recruited Woman Close to Nvidia CEO
US Believes Woman Close to Nvidia CEO Was a China Spy, NYT Says
Spy targeting Nvidia CEO was alleged China intelligence service recruit: NYT
stories.line: US memo reportedly says China tapped an exec to spy on Nvidia's CEO
stories.detail: Memo alleges China's Ministry of State Security recruited Megaspeed's Alice Huang to gather AI chip intel.

stories.headline: Claude Code approval files expose company secrets on GitHub
stories.summary: Apiiro researchers found that Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" feature can store database passwords and other credentials in local settings files that end up committed to public GitHub repositories. The researchers identified 1,122 public files containing secrets out of 104,185 examined public copies.
stories.why_it_matters: It highlights a security risk where routine AI tool approvals can inadvertently publish sensitive credentials if local configuration files are tracked in version control.
source_titles: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" exposes passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
Claude Code's “Don't Ask Again” File Exposes Passwords and Keys in 1,122 Public Copies on GitHub
Claude Code approval files found exposing company secrets on GitHub, says Apirro researchers
stories.line: Apiiro: Claude Code approval settings leak credentials into public repos
stories.detail: 1,122 of 104,185 public copies examined held passwords and other secrets saved via "Don't Ask Again".

stories.headline: Elvis Presley estate sues Suno over voice cloning and copyright infringement
stories.summary: Elvis Presley Enterprises filed a lawsuit against AI music company Suno, alleging copyright infringement and unauthorized voice cloning under Tennessee's ELVIS Act. The case follows a previous lawsuit filed by the estate against Anthropic over song training data.
stories.why_it_matters: This lawsuit represents a major test of new state legislation designed to protect artists against AI voice and likeness cloning.
source_titles: Elvis Presley Estate Warns The Next Elvis Wont Pick up a Guitar in New Lawsuit Against AI Music Company Suno
Elvis Presley Rights Owners Sue Suno Over AI Voice Cloning: ‘Elvis’ Identity Was Stolen’
Elvis estate, Eminem publisher file lawsuits against AI startup Suno
stories.line: Elvis Presley's estate takes Suno to court over AI voice cloning
stories.detail: Suit cites copyright and Tennessee's ELVIS Act; the estate earlier sued Anthropic over song training data.
